original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）政客因宣传埃博拉防疫遭殴打致死
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 刚果（金）执政党UDPS成员玛丽-塞莱斯坦·卡龙德瓦在电台采访中宣传埃博拉防疫知识后，于周日在该国北基伍省布滕博遭当地居民袭击，被殴打致死。UDPS称其财物被抢、房屋被纵火。该事件目前为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Butembo, in DR Congo's North Kivu province

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）政客卡龙德瓦在宣传埃博拉防疫后遭殴打致死
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A Congolese politician has been beaten to death after promoting Ebola awareness during a radio interview.

key_facts.fact: 袭击发生在北基伍省布滕博，袭击者为当地居民
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Marie-Celestin Karondwa from the ruling UDPS party was attacked on Sunday by residents of Butembo, in DR Congo's North Kivu province.

key_facts.fact: UDPS称其财物被抢、房屋被纵火
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The UDPS said Karondwa was beaten, his belongings were stolen and his house set on fire.

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
袭击动机尚未获独立确认
